condition: From pydantic 2.9 on, a tagged union that uses a callable Discriminator and is validated from ORM objects (Django models with from_attributes) can dump the nested model as a repr-style string like "id=1 name=foobar" instead of a dict.
workaround: Pin pydantic to 2.8.2. Another option is a discriminator function that also returns the right tag when it gets the already-validated pydantic model instance, which happens during serialization.
